source_annotations.BENCH_FUSED: J2 external DC input through F1; source presence annotation only, not fuse qualification
source_annotations.GND: Secondary common return from J2 and isolated module output; never primary POE_RECT_NEG
source_annotations.3V3: U7 switch output through L4; VOS is a sense input, not an output pin
source_annotations.ETH_3V3A: 3V3 through FB2; ferrite does not propagate ERC power drive
source_annotations.24V_OR: Q1/Q2 drains fed by protected bench and isolated PoE paths; U9/U10 OUT pins are sense inputs
source_annotations.5V: U6 switch output through L3; inductor does not propagate ERC power drive

limitations: Flags declare verified topology across passive elements. They do not prove startup, regulation, protection or PCB current capacity. Imported pin types outside reviewed regulators remain incomplete.
